Special City Council Meeting
AGENDA
A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL
1245 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California
4:00 p.m.
November 26, 2012
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
The City Council will listen to the public on any item on the agenda. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda.
The City Council will listen to the public on any numbered item on the agenda or any item that is not on the agenda but relevant to City business. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda. If you wish to speak to the Council, please complete a Speaker's Card and present it before the agenda item is called. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Council. Should you need to provide written documentation to the City, please give the City Manager a minimum of seven (7) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed appropriately. Comments will generally be limited to three minutes per speaker. However, a shorter limit may be declared by the Mayor for agenda items for which many Speaker Cards have been submitted.
OPENING CEREMONIES
1.
CALL MEETING TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
FLAG SALUTE
4.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS No. 5, No. 6 and No. 7, BELOW:

ARGUMENT IN FAVOR OF MEASURE A - EXPAND GANN LIMIT
RECOMMENDATION: Sign and submit the argument in favor of Measure A with the wording agreed upon at this meeting.

6.

RECOMMENDATION: Sign and submit the argument in favor of Measure B with the wording agreed upon at this meeting.
ITEM 6 - ARGUMENT IN FAVOR OF MEASURE B - INCREASE EXTRACTION TAX.PDF
7.
SKYLINE DRIVE SLOPE REPAIR - AUTHORIZE CHANGE ORDERS
RECOMMENDATION:
A. Authorize Change Orders 1 through 5 to the Skyline Drive Slope Repair construction contract and authorize final payment to T.W. Contractors, Inc.
B. Authorize the City Manager to pay the final invoice to CNC Engineering if she determines that the additional work was warranted.

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS
UPON ADJOURNMENT OF THE MEETING, PLEASE LEAVE THE ROOM PROMPTLY AND TAKE YOUR PERSONAL BELONGINGS WITH YOU TO ALLOW STAFF TO CLEAN UP AND CLOSE THE BUILDING. IF YOU ARE RECORDING, PLEASE NOTE THAT THE CONVERSATIONS THAT TAKE PLACE FROM THIS POINT FORWARD MAY BE PRIVATE, ARE NOT PART OF THE PUBLIC MEETING AND CONSENT OF ALL PARTIES TO THE CONVERSATION MAY BE REQUIRED PRIOR TO RECORDING.
